description: The actual Issue #27 receipt from commit 0205722, mapped to the custody schema. This is the real receipt that was sealed and later found to have a false claim. It should be REJECTED by every relevant invariant.
_historical_mapping: This fixture maps the original receipt (tscp-ntt-equivalence-receipt-v1 schema) to the custody schema for validation. The original receipt had no authority, build_identity, observation, claim_scope, or fallback_policy fields — those were all added by PR #29. The mapping preserves the problematic claims while exposing which invariants they violate.

claim_scope.claimed_scope: butterfly oracle equivalence across scalar and avx512 backends, plus NTT correctness, stage equivalence, round trip, and representation invariants
claim_scope.verified_scope: butterfly_reference_agreement test passed (but only scalar path exercised — butterfly() delegates to scalar_butterfly_32). staged_cross_backend_equivalence passed (but silently skips on non-AVX-512 hardware). No AVX-512-specific evidence for butterfly oracle equivalence.
claim_scope._violation: The receipt claims backends ['scalar', 'avx512'] for butterfly.oracle_equivalence, but the cited test (butterfly_reference_agreement) only exercises the scalar path. The avx512 claim is unsupported by evidence.

execution._violation: butterfly() delegates to scalar_butterfly_32(). The receipt claims avx512 backend coverage. This is a silent fallback baked into the function — not recorded as a fallback in the original receipt.

fallback_policy._violation: Fallback was used (butterfly() -> scalar_butterfly_32()) but the receipt claims avx512 backend coverage.

hardware.cpu_model: unknown — not recorded in original receipt
hardware.feature_probe_method: none — not recorded in original receipt
hardware._violation: The original receipt lists 'AVX-512 hardware execution' in trusted_base but provides no hardware verification. staged_cross_backend_equivalence silently skips when is_avx512_supported() returns false. No feature probe was recorded.

test.name: butterfly_reference_agreement
test.oracle_independence: butterfly_reference is composed from babybear_mul_reference + babybear_add/sub_reference, sharing no code with the implementation. Reference oracle is in field::babybear::reference.
test._note: The oracle IS independent. But the test calls butterfly() which delegates to scalar. The test proves scalar equivalence, not AVX-512 equivalence.

observation.method: none — not recorded in original receipt
observation.independence_note: The original receipt records oracle_independence (the reference oracle is independent) but does not record observation independence (no disassembly, no feature probe, no harness isolation verification). The receipt was generated by the test runner, not by an independent observer.
observation._violation: No independent observation mechanism was recorded. The receipt relies on the test runner's self-report of pass/fail. No disassembly verification, no feature probe, no harness isolation.

authority._note: The original receipt has no authority fields. The 'result: ACCEPT' in the original receipt is an evidence result, not an authorization. Mapped as granted: false (no authority violation — the original receipt didn't claim authority).

lifecycle._note: Status is REVOKED because the claim was false (avx512 backend coverage was never established), not merely replaced. This is the Issue #27 receipt.

build_identity._violation: The original receipt records commit SHAs but no build artifact identity. No compiler version, no artifact hash, no dependency lock hash. Two compilations of the same commit with different flags could produce different codegen.
